## What's changed in v0.10.0

- Edit adult vanilla villagers' professions and trade tiers (experimental). Profession changes reset offers and trading experience; replace the workstation in Minecraft as shown in the preview.
- Select villagers by dragging an area on the map and save selections as named regions. Keep region forms compact and show errors beside the fields.
- Read cached villager details while the server runs, find saved player positions across dimensions, and identify affected residents in grouped scan diagnostics.
- Preserve fine player position and movement-speed edits, and recheck source records immediately before saving.
- Fix shifting detail buttons and keyboard focus during workspace navigation.

## Updating

Close the editor, extract the new ZIP into a fresh folder and copy your existing `data` folder into it.

The unsigned Windows app (`_windows_x64.zip`) requires WebView2. For the browser runtime (`_runtime.zip`), run `setup.bat` before `start.bat`. Each ZIP has a matching `.sha256` file.

Back up your world and stop Minecraft or the Bedrock server before editing.
